auth_methods.quote: System users represent servers or software making API calls to assets owned or managed by a Business Manager
auth_methods.note: User access tokens via Facebook Login OAuth dialog (ads_management/ads_read) for third-party users; System User access tokens for own-business automation. Quote supports system-user tokens; OAuth quote is on /docs/marketing-api/overview/authorization ('standard Facebook oAuth flow' on system-users page too).

credential_access.quote: Automatically granted when you add the Marketing API product to your app.
credential_access.note: Limited access tier is automatic with a free developer app (needs an ad account). Limited tier is development-only.

production_gate.quote: Heavily rate-limited per ad account. For development only. Not for production apps running for live advertisers.
production_gate.note: Full access tier requires App Review (and Business Verification for sensitive data) before production use for other advertisers.

api_type.quote: The Marketing API is a collection of Graph API endpoints and other features that can be used to help you advertise across Meta technologies.

mcp_official.quote: The ads MCP server is a Meta-hosted Model Context Protocol
mcp_official.note: Official remote server at mcp.facebook.com/ads (open beta per docs).

main_blocker_type.quote: Your tier is determined by whether your app has been approved through App Review.
main_blocker_type.note: App Review for Full access tier is the main obstacle for production multi-tenant use.
